Common.toolOffHint: Turn it on in Settings › Features (the world reloads).

Session.logOff: The session log is turned off.
Session.notePlaceholder: What happened? Start with ? for an open thread.
Session.noEvents: Nothing of this kind logged yet.
Session.more: Showing the newest {n}; the journal has them all.
Session.none: No session logged yet. Start one and the timeline fills in as you play.

Board.noToolkit: Active quests come from {name}'s quest log when that module is active.
Board.noNpcs: No NPCs linked from active quests.
Board.noJournals: No journals linked from active quests.
Board.noScenes: No scenes linked from active quests.
Board.dropHint: Drop actors, journals, pages, scenes, tables, items, playlists or macros here (up to {n}).

Check.pick: Pick a scene on the left
Check.readOnly: Read-only: nothing in the scene is changed. Only ignoring a finding is saved (on the scene).
Check.saved: The last result per scene is kept in this browser only (never in the world).
Check.clearSavedHint: Forget the scene-check results saved in this browser for this world? Ignored findings (saved on the scenes) stay.

Online.title: Who's online
Online.dragHint: Drag to move · double-click to put back
Online.noHubs: No scene is marked Hub (Scene Configuration › Table Tools): the panel shows only in its window.

Past.noneHint: Ended sessions are listed here with a link to their journal.

Features.hint: A tool that's off registers nothing (no hooks, buttons or key bindings). Saving a change reloads the world.

Tools.clearAllHint: Stops ignoring every finding you ignored, on every scene (asks first).

Data.removeHint: A dry run comes first; nothing changes until you tick, type REMOVE and confirm.
Data.showDataHint: The GM-only data journals of Red Book and your other modules sit in a "Module data" journal folder that is hidden from the Journal sidebar. Tick to show it in this browser. This is tidiness, not secrecy: players' browsers still receive those journals.
Data.windowsHint: Red Book's windows open where you last left them in this browser ({n} remembered). Reset puts them back at their default spot the next time they open.

Prep.title: Prep list
Prep.allOnBoard: Every failure is on the board.
Prep.none: Nothing to fix. Send failed findings here from the Scene check page.
Prep.cap: The list holds up to {max} items; Done takes an item off.

Next.title: Next session
Next.label: Date and time of the next session

Discord.testHint: Posts a short message from this browser to check the webhook.
Discord.honor: Honor system: players can read the webhook URL from the browser console (world settings reach every browser). Use a webhook for one channel only, and delete it in Discord if it leaks.

Previously.title: Previously on…
Previously.preview: Preview: only you see this. Players see it when you click Show to players, or when a session starts.
Previously.none: No recap has been shared with players yet.

Npcs.title: NPCs met
Npcs.none: Nobody met yet. NPC tokens on the active scene, or a scene a player is viewing, are listed once they're visible.
Npcs.removeHint: They leave the NPCs met list and their name leaves the Met line on the timeline. They won't be added again this session.

Attend.title: At the table this session
Attend.none: Nobody listed yet. Players who are connected are added automatically.
Attend.milestoneHint: e.g. Reached level 4 after clearing the mine
Attend.xpHint: Experience numbers are GM only; players see milestone text, never experience.

Timer.break: The session has run {time}. Time for a break?

Prompt.title: Start a session?
Prompt.body: No session is open. Start one now? While it's open, Red Book keeps a timeline of what happens.
Prompt.never: Don't ask again in this browser
Prompt.neverDone: you won't be asked again in this browser. Change it under Session log › Ask to start a session when the world loads.
Prompt.dragHint: Drag to move · double-click to put back
